# False positive samples — these must NOT trigger secret detection.

# Normal base64 strings
dGhpcyBpcyBhIHRlc3Q=
SGVsbG8gV29ybGQ=

# Empty/short password fields
password = ""
password = 'x'
password: ''

# Comments mentioning key terms
# api_key is required for external service
# Set the API key in your .env file

# Placeholder values in templates
API_KEY=your_api_key_here
DB_PASS=changeme
SECRET=replace_this_value

# CDK resource names that contain key-like patterns
BgTestNetworkStack
CloudFrontPrefixListId=pl-22a6434b
